name: Emblem
description: A round silver holy emblem pendant bearing a simple golden sun disk with eight rays, no writing.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original fantasy RPG pixel-art asset. Design for an actual 32 by 32 pixel canvas. Broad flat color clusters, 12-20 colors, dark one-logical-pixel outline, light from upper left, strong readable silhouette. No gradients, blur, dithering, texture noise, text, watermark, UI panel, border, ground shadow or tiny decoration. Keep all identifying features readable after reduction to 32x32. Subject: A round silver holy emblem pendant bearing a simple golden sun disk with eight rays, no writing. Genuine transparent background. One complete centered subject with a one-pixel clear margin. Full body for creatures, full object for equipment. No scenery or extra objects beyond the stated subject.
